title: Home
body: BX Docs BX Docs is a BoxLang module that generates static documentation sites from Markdown, in the spirit of mkdocs and mkdocs-material . This very site is built by BX Docs, from the Markdown files in this repository's own docs/ folder - see Getting Started to build it yourself. Highlights Markdown in, static HTML out. title: Getting Started
body: Getting Started Install BX Docs depends on bx-markdown for Markdown rendering and bx-esapi for HTML-encoding. With CommandBox installed: box install bx-docs box install bx-markdown box install bx-esapi Scaffold a project boxlang module:bxDocs new my-docs cd my-docs This creates: my-docs/ ├── docs/ │ ├── assets/ │ └── index.md └── bxdocs.json Pass --theme=material or --theme=tailwind to scaffold wi…

title: Search
body: Search BX Docs' search is fully static and client-side - the same approach mkdocs uses by default: an index built once at build time, and lunr.js doing the actual searching in the visitor's browser. There's no server, database, or external search service involved. title: Deploying to GitHub Pages
body: Deploying to GitHub Pages site/ is a plain static site - host it anywhere that serves static files. This module ships a ready-to-use GitHub Actions workflow ( .github/workflows/pages.yml ) for the common case: publishing straight to GitHub Pages, with main and development published as two independently-live versions of the same site. title: Markdown Extensions
body: Markdown Extensions Beyond standard Markdown, BX Docs turns on three of bx-markdown's native Flexmark extensions by default - admonitions, footnotes and definition lists plus a Mermaid diagram integration of its own.
